nar.text: At 9:00 AM General Francesco De Pinedo lowered the flag and the roaring pack leaped from the grid with loud rumble.
The Bugattis of Saccomani and Nuvolari took the immediate lead chased by Campari's fast Alfa Romeo.
Simons' white Bugatti remained on the grid with a faulty ignition.
At Capelle Campari was still in first place, as he was at the grandstands when he completed the first lap in 12m55.8s at 118.451 km/h.
After a gap of 15 seconds Brilli Peri appeared, followed by Nuvolari and Materassi 40 seconds later.
Varzi had stopped at his pit because the carburetion was faulty and the spark plugs were malfunctioning.
Campari laps in 12m32.6s and leads Brilli Peri by 48 seconds.
Campari's lead increased again on the third lap when Brilli in second place was 58 seconds behind and Materassi followed 1m30s behind in third place.
After three laps, Platé, made another stop and retired.
Brilli Peri pits from second: three tyres and the carburettor checked.
Arcangeli pits with a flat tyre and lubrication trouble.
On the fifth lap De Sterlich retired at Monte Silvano with a broken oil pipe.
On lap six Materassi again headed for the pits, put water in the radiator and restarted immediately.
On lap seven Materassi stopped once more. The radiator erupted like a volcano.
Materassi retires; Nuvolari inherits second ahead of Brilli Peri.
On lap nine Campari stopped at the pits, filled up with fuel and oil and changed front tires. After four minutes he restarted to the delight of the public in the grandstands.
On lap ten Brilli Peri stopped, filled up and joined the race after three minutes.
Tonini also refueled really fast and started again after only 1m48s, while Maglione retired with a broken oil pipe.
Nuvolari had lost several minutes in his pit which dropped him to fifth place.
Campari pits for rear tyres and restarts after 3m45s.
In the meantime Materassi replaced his teammate Arcangeli in the 1500 Talbot
Surprisingly Brilli Peri retired with a broken oil pipe after he had pushed his troublesome Bugatti for about one kilometer.
Tonini had inherited second place on lap 12 and chased after the unattainable red car of Campari.
Materassi, in the Talbot taken over from Arcangeli, sets the fastest 1500 lap so far: 13m08.8s.
When Tonini stopped at his pit, he lost second place to Saccomani.
Bona is hit in the lip by a stone; Ramponi takes over his Alfa Romeo.
Materassi in Arcangeli's Talbot drove at an incredibly fast pace and passed Saccomani for third place.
On lap 17 Campari was again in his pit and restarted after a 2m13s stop. In spite of his many stops, he always maintained first place.
Materassi passes Tonini for second place.
After 20 laps, Campari was the first to cross the finish line to frantic cheers from the grandstand crowd.
